taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-15, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1132.2 | 7.42 | 7.42
2 | 3621.5 | 17.67 | 25.09
3 | 4447.9 | 1.70 | 26.79
4 | 4307.5 | 0.53 | 27.32
5 | 7664.9 | 4.92 | 32.24
6 | 12762.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as HKHA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-15, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note – Station T-15, Survey Area T**

The interpreted VES model at T-15 comprises six layers with resistivities increasing overall with depth, from 1132.2 Ω·m near surface to 12762.9 Ω·m in the basal layer, with a shallow subsurface zone (layers 3–4) showing a resistivity dip/plateau (4447.9 → 4307.5 Ω·m) before the resistivity rises again. Depths to layer base range from 7.42 m to 32.24 m, with the deepest tested interface at 32.24 m.

Recomputing the curve type from the resistivity sequence (r1<r2<r3 → A; r2<r3>r4 → K; r3>r4<r5 → H; r4<r5<r6 → A) gives **AKHA**, not the **HKHA** currently on file. The discrepancy lies in the first segment (r1<r2, not r1>r2), so the filed label appears to be in error.

{"curve_type_stated": "HKHA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
